vulnerability.description: Unbounded memory growth in the OpenSSL QUIC server listener enables a remote denial of service.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-14456
vulnerability.description: Unbounded memory growth in the OpenSSL QUIC server listener enables a remote denial of service.

statements.impact_statement: OpenSSL sits in the image as a Debian base package; the Vulnlog binary links only libc and libz, so libssl is never loaded. Vulnlog is an offline CLI that reads and writes local files, opens no sockets, and therefore runs no QUIC listener that an attacker could flood with Initial packets.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-53612
vulnerability.description: Time-of-check-time-of-use flaw in util-linux `mount(8)` when it applies post-mount ownership or mode changes.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-53612
vulnerability.description: Time-of-check-time-of-use flaw in util-linux `mount(8)` when it applies post-mount ownership or mode changes.

statements.impact_statement: util-linux enters the image through the Debian base only; the entrypoint is the Vulnlog native binary, which links just libc and libz and never invokes `mount(8)`. The attack needs an `/etc/fstab` entry combining `user` with `X-mount.owner`, `X-mount.group` or `X-mount.mode`, and the image ships an unconfigured fstab with no entries at all.

statements.impact_statement: util-linux enters the image through the Debian base only; the entrypoint is the Vulnlog native binary, which links just libc and libz and never invokes `mount(8)`. Reaching the race requires an `/etc/fstab` entry with the `user` or `users` option, and the image ships an unconfigured fstab with no entries at all.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-85091
vulnerability.description: Heap buffer overflow in zlib `gz_vacate()` when `gzprintf()` follows a stalled non-blocking `gzwrite()`.

statements.impact_statement: The Vulnlog binary links zlib, but imports only the `inflate`, `deflate` and `crc32` routines behind `java.util.zip` and no `gz*` function. The overflow needs `gzprintf()` or `gzvprintf()` after a stalled non-blocking `gzwrite()`, which Vulnlog never calls.
